description: This file defines the HostModeCtrl class, which manages thread synchronization for switching between Android Mode and Confirmation UI Mode within the WebRTC service, specifically for screen connector operations.

classes.name: HostModeCtrl
classes.description: A class that orchestrates concurrent thread execution to manage modes (Android or Confirmation UI) in the WebRTC service.

methods.name: WaitAndroidMode
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until the mode is Android Mode, using a combination of atomic check and condition variable wait for efficiency.

methods.name: SetMode
methods.description: Sets the current mode (Android or Confirmation UI) and notifies waiting threads accordingly.

methods.name: IsConfirmatioUiMode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is Confirmation UI Mode.

methods.name: IsAndroidMode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is Android Mode.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of HostModeCtrl.
